title: Isolation and analyses of lamina propria lymphocytes from mouse intestines
protocol: Euthanize mice by CO2 inhalation.
Make a small incision in the abdomen to expose the abdominal wall.
Rip open the outer skin of the incision.
Find and cut the terminal colon with scissors.
Gently pull out the intestines from the mouse.
Take the desired part of the intestines.
Place the intestinal segment in a multi-well plate containing 5 mL HBSS (without Ca2+, Mg2+) on ice.
Keep all samples submerged in HBSS and on ice while processing other samples.
Optionally, add 2% FBS into HBSS to improve cell viability.
Trim intestine samples.
Transfer intestines onto ice-cold HBSS soaked paper towels.
Trim surrounding fat tissues and Peyer’s patches.
Remove intestinal content by gently pushing from one end to the other.
Alternatively, use a syringe with HBSS to remove intestinal contents.
Slide in angled forceps into intestines and cut longitudinally.
Wash sample twice in ice-cold HBSS.
Clean mucus off tissue gently on wet paper towel.
Transfer tissue into a new multi-well plate with 5 mL HBSS on ice.
Prepare 15 mL of EDTA-DTT buffer per sample.
Prewarm the EDTA-DTT buffer at 37°C until use.
Aliquot 15 mL of EDTA-DTT buffer to each conical tube.
Transfer intestinal tissues to the DTT-EDTA buffer.
Incubate the tissues in a shaker.
Vortex vigorously.
Remove residual solutions by scrubbing the tissues on a paper towel.
Rinse the tissues with ice-cold RPMI-1640 media.
Transfer the tissues to the digestion buffer.
Transfer the digested tissues to the strainer top tubes.
Resuspend cell pellets with 1 mL of 40% Percoll solution and transfer to prepared 15 mL conical tube with 4 mL of 40% Percoll solution.
Add 2.5 mL of 80% Percoll solution to the bottom of the tubes using glass Pasteur pipettes.
Remove the upper 40% Percoll solution from the top.
Collect the cells (lymphocytes) from the interface.
Incubate the tissues in a shaker at 37°C, 250 rpm for 15 min.
Place the tubes at a 45° angle for better shaking.
Vortex each sample vigorously at maximum speed (∼3,000 rpm) for 10 s.
Prepare 2 Petri dishes with 20 mL ice-cold RPMI-1640 media.
Take the tissue out of the EDTA-DTT buffer and remove residual solution by scrubbing the tissue on a clean paper towel.
Rinse the tissues with ice-cold RPMI-1640 media.
Scrub the rinsed tissues on a clean paper towel to thoroughly remove dissociated cells.
Prepare the digestion media with prewarmed RPMI-1640 media.
Adjust the concentration of Liberase depending on tissue types.
Prepare a 50 mL conical tube per sample.
Aliquot 5 mL of digestion buffer to each conical tube.
Transfer tissues to the digestion buffer in prepared conical tubes.
Incubate the tissues at 37°C, 250 rpm for 40 min to 1 h.
Vigorously shake the tubes every 15 min during incubation.
Prepare new 50 mL conical tubes with 100 μm cell strainers on top.
Transfer digested tissues through the strainers into new tubes after incubation.
Vortex vigorously for 10 s after transferring tissues.
Pour the digested cell suspensions through the cell strainer.
Discard small non-dissociated pieces of tissue.
Add 15 mL of ice-cold HBSS to the original 50 mL conical tube to rinse residual cells.
Centrifuge the samples at 450 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Prepare 80% Percoll and 40% Percoll solutions.
Aliquot 4 mL of 40% Percoll solution to each 15 mL conical tube.
Resuspend the cell pellets with 1 mL of 40% Percoll solution.
Transfer the resuspended cells into the prepared 15 mL conical tubes containing 4 mL of 40% Percoll solution.
Add 2.5 mL of 80% Percoll solution to the bottom of each tube using a glass Pasteur pipette.
Place the glass Pasteur pipettes in the center of the tubes and slowly apply 2.5 mL of 80% Percoll solution through them.
Wait until all 80% Percoll is added before removing the pipettes to maintain the interface.
Gently move the samples to the centrifuge without disturbing the 40/80% Percoll interface.
Centrifuge the samples at 860 × g for 20 minutes at 21°C with acceleration set to 0 or 1 and no brake.
Prepare a new 15 mL conical tube per sample and add 10 mL of HBSS.
Remove the upper 40% Percoll solution until approximately 4 mL of total solution remain.
Use a transfer pipette to collect the cells at the interface between the Percoll layers.
Transfer the collected lymphocytes to the newly prepared 15 mL tube containing HBSS.
Thoroughly mix by inverting and centrifuge at 450 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 10 mL of HBSS to the pellet and centrifuge at 450 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C to wash the pellet.
Discard the supernatant.
Mix 5 mL of FACS buffer to resuspend the cell pellet if pausing the experiment.
Keep cells at 4°C during the pause period.
Resuspend the pellet with 200 μL of HBSS if cell stimulation is not required.
Transfer cells to a 96-well round bottom plate for flow cytometry analyses directly.
Prewarm 2× T cell stimulation media if lymphocyte stimulation is required.
Aliquot 100 μL of prewarmed media into each well of a 96-well round bottom plate, including one well for an unstained control.
Resuspend each sample cell pellet with base T cell culture media.
Count the cell number using a Burker chamber or automated cell counter with Trypan Blue staining.
Determine the total volume of the resuspension based on the desired number of cells for stimulation.
Take 100 μL of each sample cell suspension and add it to the corresponding well containing 2× T cell stimulation media.
Thoroughly mix by pipetting gently.
Take 100 μL of any residual cell suspension and add it to the unstained control well.
Incubate the 96-well plate in a 5% CO2, 37°C cell culture incubator for 2–3 h.
Take the 96-well plate from the cell culture incubator.
Centrifuge the 96-well plate at 450 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant by flipping the 96 well plate.
Wash cells by adding 200 μL/well of HBSS without resuspending.
Repeat steps 36–38 twice.
After the last centrifugation, remove the supernatant by flipping the 96-well plate.
Add 50 μL/well of fixable live/dead viability staining solution and resuspend.
Incubate at 4°C for 10 min. The plate should be covered with aluminum foil from this step on.
Add 150 μL/well of HBSS to wash and centrifuge at 450 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant by flipping the 96-well plate.
Add 50 μL/well of Fc Blocker solution and resuspend.
Add 150 μL/well of HBSS to wash the cells.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 2 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant by flipping the 96-well plate.
Prepare antibody mix 1 as indicated in Table 1 for surface markers staining.
Add 50 μL/well of antibody mixture and resuspend cells gently.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min. The plate should be covered with aluminum foil.
Add 150 μL/well of HBSS to wash the cells.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 2 min.
Remove the supernatant by flipping the 96-well plate.
Repeat steps for washing and centrifuging.
Prepare Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization working solution.
Resuspend the cells with 150 μL/well of the working solution and incubate for 20–30 min at 20°C–22°C. The plate should be covered with aluminum foil.
Centrifuge at 860 × g for 2 min.
Remove supernatant by flipping the plate.
Prepare 1× Permeabilization buffer working solution.
Add 200 μL of Permeabilization buffer to each well.
Centrifuge at 860 × g for 2 min.
Remove supernatant by flipping the plate.
Repeat steps 58 and 59.
Prepare the antibody mix as indicated in Table 2 for intracellular cytokines and transcription factors (Intracellular cytokine/transcription factors staining panel).
Add 50 μL of antibody mixture to each well.
Incubate at 4°C for 1 h, covered with aluminum foil.
Centrifuge at 860 × g for 2 min.
Remove supernatant by flipping the plate.
Repeat twice.
Resuspend cells with 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Optional: Add counting beads (Cat. 424902, Biolegend) to each well according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Collect data with flow cytometry analyzer (LSRII, BD Biosciences).
Analyze by using FlowJo software (FlowJo, LLC).
